summary: Today’s PaymentsDive recap: 8 new stories, with focus on fraud/security, regulation.

articles.title: Visa’s revenue momentum slows
articles.description: The card network’s recent revenue growth slowed in July, relative to last year, but customer spending remains healthy, the company said.

articles.title: Pex aims to expand card biz
articles.description: The spend-management firm raised money from investors to grow its corporate card and finance software business.

articles.title: PayPal leans into financial services
articles.description: The company’s CEO said that buy now, pay later and other consumer finance offerings will pump up revenue, but some analysts have doubts.

articles.title: How ISO consolidation persists
articles.description: Global Payments and other processors have been gobbling up smaller firms for years, but payments professionals keep forming new ones.

articles.title: Mastercard bolsters scam defense
articles.description: The card network and rival Visa are each pursuing new rules to induce merchants and their banks to join the fight against fraud.

articles.title: Keeping pace with the next era of commerce payments
articles.description: Discover the strategic path to modernizing payments for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

articles.title: OCC denies Wise a trust charter
articles.description: After the federal agency rejected its U.S. trust charter application, the British fintech plans to submit a new one under the Genius Act framework.

articles.title: Amex ups marketing, tech spend
articles.description: To keep attracting new card holders, American Express is increasing its spending on marketing and technology in the second half of this year.
